Be able to search YouTube Shorts effectively to find a Short she watched earlier. → Share
Shorts through the share button on WhatsApp with friends and family to keep in touch.

Apply the duration (over 20 minutes) and upload-date filters when searching long-form cont
ent, to find the latest in-depth video on an evolved technical concept. → Watch a full lon
g-form video to dive deeper into a subject.

Keep her watch history enabled so YouTube keeps recommending content related to what she w
ants to watch instead of unrelated recommendations. → Keep looking through YouTube's large
volume of videos until she finds content she likes.
